name: Exp_Ichimoku_Osc
summary: This EA trades based on an Ichimoku Oscillator custom indicator that smooths the difference between Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen using configurable smoothing algorithms. It opens buy positions when the oscillator turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with optional position closing on reverse signals. Trade sizing is handled via multiple money management modes with fixed stop loss and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义的Ichimoku振荡器指标进行交易，该指标使用可配置的平滑算法对Tenkan-sen与Kijun-sen的差值进行平滑处理。当振荡器向上转折时开多仓，向下转折时开空仓，并可选择在反向信号时平仓。交易仓位通过多种资金管理模式配合固定止损止盈来控制。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Ichimoku振荡器，即Tenkan-sen与Kijun-sen之差的平滑值，本质上是将一目均衡表的趋势信号转化为动量振荡器形式。入场条件为：当振荡器值从下降转为上升（Value[1]<Value[2]且Value[0]>=Value[1]）时开多仓，当振荡器值从上升转为下降（Value[1]>Value[2]且Value[0]<=Value[1]）时开空仓。出场条件包括固定止损（1000点）和固定止盈（2000点），以及反向信号触发的平仓（BuyPosClose/SellPosClose）。仓位管理支持五种模式：按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后自由保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例和固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制投入比例，默认0.1即10%。信号仅在新区块或指定信号柱上计算，避免重复开仓，但缺乏对已有同方向仓位的检查机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on an Ichimoku Oscillator which smooths the difference between Tenkan-sen and Kijun-sen, essentially converting Ichimoku trend signals into a momentum oscillator form. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the oscillator turns upward (Value[1]<Value[2] and Value[0]>=Value[1]), and a sell position opens when it turns downward (Value[1]>Value[2] and Value[0]<=Value[1]). Exit conditions include a fixed stop loss of 1000 points, a fixed take profit of 2000 points, and reverse signal closing controlled by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags. Position sizing supports five modes: percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of free margin after losses, percentage of balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter at a default of 0.1 (10%), and the MMMode parameter selects the calculation method. Signals are only calculated on new bars or the specified signal bar to prevent repeated entries, but the EA lacks a check for existing positions in the same direction, potentially leading to multiple overlapping entries.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制仓位大小

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 资金管理模式：自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (fixed lot/balance %/free margin % etc.)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平多仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing long positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许反向信号平空仓
parameters.description_en: Allow closing short positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: Tenkan
parameters.description: 一目均衡表转折线周期

parameters.name: Kijun
parameters.description: 一目均衡表基准线周期

parameters.name: Senkou
parameters.description: 一目均衡表先行带B周期

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于判断信号的K线索引

pros: 使用一目均衡表经典指标，理论基础扎实，Tenkan/Kijun交叉是成熟的趋势判断方法
提供10种平滑算法选择，灵活性高，可根据市场特性优化振荡器平滑效果
资金管理模式多样（5种），适应不同风险偏好和账户规模
止损止盈比例2:1，符合正向期望值交易的基本要求
可独立控制开仓和平仓方向，灵活性高
使用新区块检测避免重复信号，减少过度交易
pros_en: Uses the classic Ichimoku indicator with solid theoretical foundation; Tenkan/Kijun crossover is a well-established trend identification method
Offers 10 smoothing algorithm options providing high flexibility to optimize oscillator smoothing based on market characteristics
Multiple money management modes (5 types) accommodate different risk appetites and account sizes
Stop loss to take profit ratio of 1:2 meets the basic requirement for positive expectancy trading
Independent control over opening and closing directions provides high flexibility
New bar detection prevents repeated signal processing and reduces overtrading
cons: 缺乏对已有同方向仓位的检查，可能在同一趋势中反复开仓导致仓位过度集中
固定止损止盈不适应不同市场波动环境，在高波动期可能频繁止损，低波动期止盈难以触及
止损1000点和止盈2000点对于H8周期可能偏大，实际回撤风险较高
无点差过滤机制，在点差较大时仍可能开仓导致不利入场
依赖外部自定义指标Ichimoku_Osc，增加了部署复杂性和依赖风险
振荡器仅比较三个连续值判断转折，信号可能过于敏感产生假突破
cons_en: Lacks position check for existing same-direction trades, potentially causing repeated entries and overconcentration in one direction
Fixed stop loss and take profit do not adapt to varying market volatility; may trigger frequently in high volatility or fail to reach in low volatility
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points may be excessive for H8 timeframe, posing significant drawdown risk
No spread filter mechanism; may enter positions during high spread periods resulting in unfavorable fills
Depends on external custom indicator Ichimoku_Osc, increasing deployment complexity and dependency risk
Oscillator only compares three consecutive values to detect turns, which may be overly sensitive and produce false signals
improvements: 增加对已有同方向仓位的检查逻辑，避免重复开仓导致风险过度集中
引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自适应调整止损止盈距离
增加点差过滤和时间过滤（如避开新闻时段和低流动性时段），提高入场质量
可考虑加入云带（Kumo）过滤，仅在价格位于云带上方时做多、下方时做空，提高趋势确认可靠性
improvements_en: Add position checking logic for existing same-direction trades to prevent repeated entries and risk overconcentration
Introduce ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adaptively adjust distances based on market volatility
Add spread filter and time filter (e.g., avoid news events and low liquidity sessions) to improve entry quality
Consider adding Kumo (cloud) filter to only buy above the cloud and sell below it, improving trend confirmation reliability

risk_points: 缺乏已有仓位检查，可能在同一方向上重复开仓导致仓位叠加风险
固定止损1000点在极端行情下仍可能造成较大单笔亏损
振荡器三值比较法对噪音敏感，可能产生频繁的虚假信号导致反复止损
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标文件缺失将导致EA初始化失败
risk_points_en: Lacks existing position check which may cause repeated same-direction entries leading to position stacking risk
Fixed 1000-point stop loss can still result in significant single-trade losses during extreme market conditions
Three-value comparison oscillator is noise-sensitive and may produce frequent false signals causing repeated stop-outs
Depends on external custom indicator; missing indicator file will cause EA initialization failure
